issue.title: Character state sheet: Glyph vector geometry, 7 activity states, brow/eye/lip keyframes
issue.description: From docs/02 (concept v4 locked by Nik 2026-11-17: two eyes + brows + lips on the circle/staff/wings Glyph). Produce production SVG geometry for idle/run/review/wave/jump/failed/waiting with brow/eye/lip keyframes and wing/staff animation timing (darts and glides, never bounces). Acceptance: state sheet renders at 16px and full-screen; each state readable from face alone.
